name: conclave
description: Conclave: a DAO treasury on QoreChain that only moves on post-quantum (ML-DSA-87) votes.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix app ci && npm --prefix contracts ci
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n relayer,app -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix app run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && cd contracts && forge test
